title: Beethoven — Für Elise, WoO 59 (Mutopia typeset)

reference.license: Public Domain (Mutopia 2015/08/18-931, Stelios Samelis after Breitkopf & Härtel 1888). reference.sha256 pins the bare Mutopia .mid at reference.url (fetch copies it into the midi dir; there is no archive).

editionNotes: Same musical text as the `fur-elise` pin, but the PDF is the Mutopia LilyPond typeset at reference.url's sibling — so PDF, MIDI and .ly all come from one source and the whole entry is fetchable. `fur-elise` keeps the IMSLP scan for the hosted-vs-local shootout; do not cross the two.
LilyPond \tempo 4 = 72 under a transparent MetronomeMark; the printed heading is 'Poco moto.' in 3/8 with a one-eighth pickup (pickupQuarters 0.5).

performedBars is deliberately NOT pinned. The .ly carries two \repeat volta 2 blocks whose \alternative endings use \set Timing.measurePosition to borrow an eighth across the barline, so the printed bar numbering is irregular and a performed-bar count cannot be read off the source by hand. An unpinned performedBars makes performedBarsMatch null and the repeat gate skips this movement rather than asserting a number nobody verified. Close it by rendering the .ly with LilyPond and reading the last bar number of an unfolded score.
printedBars 105 is the uniform-3/8 bar count the MIDI produces (verify with `run` — refBars in the summary), not LilyPond's printed numbering, which the measurePosition borrowing shifts.
Do not embed document UUIDs. --from document cannot --out a baseline-* oracle.
No ornament signs (the \grace and \appoggiatura figures are ordinary notes in the reference MIDI), so expectedExtraNotes is 0.
